product_overview: Mawashi Manager is a comprehensive livestock management platform designed to streamline barn and livestock tracking, purchase and sales operations, expense management, and financial contributions with advanced reporting and user role management.
core_goals: Provide secure and role-based access control to ensure data privacy and action permissions.
Offer a centralized dashboard with key performance indicators and financial summaries to monitor livestock and business health.
Enable efficient barn and livestock management including CRUD operations and detailed tracking.
Facilitate purchase and sales workflows including immediate and deferred payments with invoice and receipt generation.
Support financial transparency with expense tracking, cash contributions, wallet management, and settlement processes.
Deliver robust reporting capabilities including daily, advanced, livestock movement reports with print and export options.
Ensure system reliability with audit logs, database backup/restore, and performance monitoring.
Provide a user-friendly and responsive UI with theme support, mobile detection, and consistent design components.
key_features: Authentication & Authorization system with role-based access and granular permission management.
Dashboard & Overview with interactive charts and financial summaries.
Barn and Livestock Management with CRUD, status updates, and capacity tracking.
Livestock Types Management to categorize animal types effectively.
Purchase Management including supplier info, payment records, and livestock creation automation.
Sales Management with POS interface, deferred payment options, and invoice/receipt handling.
Islamic charitable Vows (Nadhr) Management with donation tracking and receipts.
Financial Contributions tracking with multi-wallet payments and donor receipts.
Expense Management with categorized operating expenses and payment supports.
Wallet & Cash Register Management with real-time balance and transaction histories.
User Management supporting roles, custom permissions, and password handling.
Comprehensive Daily, Advanced, and Livestock Movement Reports.
Settlement System for daily close-outs and audit logging.
Audit Logging to record all user and system activities.
Database Backup & Restore capabilities for data safety.
Global Search for quick lookup across system data.
Settings Management for roles, permissions, and global configurations.
Performance Monitoring with operation timing and statistics.
Modern UI Component Library and consistent application layout.
Theme Management with dark/light mode toggle.
Session and PWA Support for enhanced user experience.
AI integration for intelligent features and assistance.
user_flow_summary: User logs in through a secure login page applying role-based access controls.
User navigates to the dashboard to view livestock metrics, financial summaries, and key indicators.
User manages barns by adding, editing, or viewing barn details and their occupancy.
User manages livestock batches or individual animals including status updates and barn assignments.
User records livestock purchases with supplier and payment details, automatically updating livestock records.
User processes livestock sales via POS or deferred payment options with invoice and receipt generation.
User tracks Islamic charitable vows by recording donated livestock and issuing receipts.
User monitors financial contributions and issues donor receipts.
User inputs and manages operating expenses categorized by type with payment handling.
User manages multiple wallets and cash registers with transaction visibility.
Admin users manage other users’ roles, permissions, and credentials securely.
User accesses various report types for financial and livestock analytics with filtering and export.
User performs daily settlement operations with audit logs and reviews settlement histories.
User searches data across the system via global search functionality.
User adjusts app settings like roles, permissions, and themes for personalized experience.
validation_criteria: User authentication and role enforcement tested to prevent unauthorized access.
Dashboard widgets display accurate and up-to-date data.
CRUD operations on barns, livestock, purchases, sales, vows, contributions, expenses, and wallets execute correctly with data validation.
Invoice and receipt generation produce correct, printable documents.
Reports generate comprehensive and filterable data sets with export options.
Audit logs capture all critical user actions and system changes.
Backup and restore operations complete without data loss or corruption.
User management functions enforce role and permission rules and allow password recovery.
UI components render consistently and responsively across supported devices and browsers.
Performance metrics collected and meet defined thresholds for responsiveness.
Theme toggling updates UI seamlessly without layout breakage.
Search queries return accurate and relevant results efficiently.
PWA install and session management work correctly, preserving user state.

features.name: Authentication & Authorization
features.description: Login/logout system with role-based access control (DEVELOPER, ADMIN, MANAGER, STAFF) and granular permission management

features.name: Dashboard & Overview
features.description: Main dashboard with livestock metrics, financial summary, status distribution, and interactive charts showing key performance indicators

features.name: Barn Management
features.description: CRUD operations for livestock housing facilities with capacity tracking and occupancy management

features.name: Livestock Management
features.description: Complete livestock tracking with batch and individual registration, status updates, barn assignment, and opening balance support

features.name: Livestock Types Management
features.description: Manage animal categories (Cow, Sheep, Goat, Chicken, etc.) with CRUD operations

features.name: Purchase Management
features.description: Record and track livestock purchases with supplier info, payment records, draft-to-confirmed workflow, and automatic livestock creation

features.name: Sales Management
features.description: Complete sales system with POS interface for immediate sales, deferred sales with installments, invoice and receipt generation, and livestock status tracking

features.name: Vows (Nadhr) Management
features.description: Islamic charitable feature for tracking donated livestock (nadhr) with donor info and receipt generation

features.name: Financial Contributions
features.description: Track cash donations with multi-wallet payment distribution and receipt generation for donors

features.name: Expense Management
features.description: Record and categorize operating expenses (Feed, Vet, Maintenance, Other) with multi-wallet payment support

features.name: Wallet & Cash Register Management
features.description: Manage multiple payment methods and cash registers with real-time balance tracking and transaction history

features.name: User Management
features.description: Complete user administration with role assignment, custom permission overrides, and password management

features.name: Daily Reports
features.description: Daily financial summary with inflows/outflows categorization, wallet snapshots, and net change calculation

features.name: Advanced Reports
features.description: Multi-filter reporting system with date range filtering and type-specific analytics

features.name: Livestock Movement Reports
features.description: Animal tracking reports showing status changes, barn movements, and population analysis

features.name: Reports Hub
features.description: Central hub for accessing all report types including available reports, bookings, and print views

features.name: Settlement System
features.description: Daily close-out operations with wallet balance snapshots, audit logging, and settlement history tracking

features.name: Audit Logging
features.description: Comprehensive audit trail tracking all user actions, changes, and system events

features.name: Database Backup & Restore
features.description: System administration feature for creating MySQL database backups and restoring from backup files

features.name: Global Search
features.description: Search interface for finding records across the entire system

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: System configuration interface for managing roles, permissions, and global settings

features.name: Performance Monitoring
features.description: Track API performance metrics including operation timing, averages, and percentile statistics

features.name: UI Component Library
features.description: Comprehensive Radix UI + Tailwind component library including forms, dialogs, dropdowns, tables, charts, and more

features.name: Layout Components
features.description: Application layout structure including header navigation and sidebar navigation

features.name: Theme Management
features.description: Dark/light mode support with next-themes integration and theme toggle component

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Client-side session context provider for managing user authentication state

features.name: PWA Support
features.description: Progressive Web App installation button and manifest configuration

features.name: Custom Hooks
features.description: React custom hooks for mobile detection and toast notifications

features.name: Utility Functions
features.description: Helper functions for Arabic date formatting, currency formatting, number formatting, age calculation, and class name merging

features.name: Type Definitions
features.description: TypeScript type definitions for all entities used across the application

features.name: Database Schema
features.description: Prisma schema defining 15 models including User, Barn, Livestock, Purchase, Sale, Vow, Contribution, Expense, Wallet, Payment, Settlement, and Log

features.name: AI Integration
features.description: Google Genkit AI integration for intelligent features

features.name: Testing Suite
features.description: Jest and React Testing Library setup with Prisma mocks for unit and integration testing
